children: Egyptian developer M squared plans to invest up to 2.5 billion Egyptian pounds ($49 million) in construction at its Masyaf Ras Alhekma development on the North Coast in 2027, Chairman and CEO Karim Malash told Zawya Projects.
The developer plans to deliver 347 units at Masyaf during 2027, with construction of the project currently around 41 percent complete, Malash said.
Masyaf Ras Alhekma represents a total investment of around EGP14 billion ($274.5 million), with M squared planning to invest a further EGP8 billion ($157 million) over the next five years, he added.

The company has partnered with Redcon Construction on works covering the 347 units, with an investment value of around EGP1 billion ($20 million). M squared also increased the capacity of Marmarica Boutique Cabanas at Masyaf to 42 units from 28.
Beyond its North Coast development, M squared plans to deliver 100 units at its Trio project in New Cairo by the end of 2026, Malash disclosed.

The developer's existing portfolio also includes 31WEST in 6th of October City, MIST residential community and 41 Business District on Kattameya Road, in addition to Trio, Masyaf Ras Alhekma and Marmarica Boutique Cabanas.
(Reporting by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
